svg.title: The steps of a reminder
svg.desc: Pick one student or several, write the message and preview. The preview shows who will receive it, who is skipped and why, and how many SMS are needed. If you change anything after the preview, preview again. When you send, at a school that counts SMS credit the credit for all the SMS is held at once; if it is too low, nothing is sent. Otherwise the message goes into the queue.
